page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.2xlarge is a storage-oriented virtual machine instance configured with 8 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB per core. A key hardware characteristic is the inclusion of 1919 GB of local SSD storage, paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate a clear performance tradeoff. The dedicated Intel Xeon processor delivers weak single-core and multi-core CPU performance, placing in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench tests. Memory read bandwidth is also constrained, scoring in the bottom 25% for both small and large block reads, though large block write bandwidth reaches average tier performance. For database operations, Redis SET operations perform at an average level of 6.06 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput remains weak at 4.61 GB/sec.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i2.2xlarge offers high local storage density and dedicated CPU resources, making it a viable option for workloads requiring significant local disk space without demanding high-performance compute. The instance is best suited for local database hosting, caching layers, and storage-heavy applications where high-speed local SSD access is prioritized over raw processing power or high-speed network throughput.
